title: Akki Roti
description: A Karnataka rice flour flatbread patted by hand with onion, dill, coconut and green chilli, crisp on the outside and soft within.
steps: Mix the rice flour with the onion, green chilli, grated coconut, dill leaves, cumin seeds and salt in a bowl.
Add about 250 ml of warm water a little at a time and knead to a soft, pliable dough without cracks.
Grease a banana leaf or a sheet of parchment with oil and put a ball of dough on it.
Pat the dough into a thin round with wet fingertips, making small holes with your finger to help it cook through.
Heat a tawa, slide the roti on, drizzle oil around it and cook covered for 2 minutes.
Flip and cook until crisp with brown spots, then serve hot with chutney or pickle.
